custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the speaker drivers. AI often generates slightly oval circles or misaligned dust caps. image_description: A single, dark grey or black bookshelf-style loudspeaker standing on a carpeted floor against a light wall. The speaker has a curved front baffle with two visible drivers: a smaller top driver (tweeter/mid-range) and a larger bottom driver (woofer). There is a control panel with blue LED indicators at the base. A power cable extends from the rear right side.

expert_testimonies.reason: To check for structural solidity of the box and ensure the drivers are properly recessed/integrated into the baffle rather than floating.
To verify the specific type of speaker (e.g., active vs passive, brand identification if possible) and confirm class alignment.
